Welcome

The ADMI 2026 Symposium brings together students, faculty, researchers, and partners for a shared exploration of computing innovation, research excellence, and inclusive opportunity. This year’s event emphasizes artificial intelligence as both a tool and a topic of study, with programming that spans faculty papers, student papers, posters, workshops, competitions, networking, and career development.

About This Site

This companion site is designed to make symposium materials easier to browse and share. As the repository grows, it can also host the full program, proceedings updates, speaker images, sponsor assets, and future archival content for ADMI 2026.

GitHub Pages note: this page expects the banner image at /images/ADMI2026_banner.jpg and ADMI logo assets under /ADMI-Logos/. Update the logo filename in this page if your primary ADMI logo uses a different name.
